Method of Attack: sends HTTP POST requests to TikTok's password recovery API and Instagram's account login endpoints to validate email addresses, targets different Instagram API endpoints with forged HTTP POST requests mimicking the Instagram Android app, triggers the forgot password flow for a given username targeting specific Instagram API endpoints
Attack Vector: HTTP POST requests to validate email addresses, forged HTTP POST requests to Instagram API endpoints, fake HTTP requests to trigger forgot password flow
Indicators of Compromise: HTTP POST requests to TikTok and Instagram APIs
